title: RegulatoryFeasibilityItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-regulatory-feasibility-checker. items carries META POINTS about regulatory-feasibility.md, not the full document — full rationale/mitigation narrative lives ONLY in the artifact, saved to s3 (blob storage). '_summary' fields are short distillations (<=~20 words, slightly longer budget than other agents since a mitigation must remain actionable even in short form). Status, citation, id, and requires_legal_review are structural facts, not prose duplication, and stay in full. Every constraint is a primary category and MUST carry a citation. Every Amber/Red constraint MUST carry a mitigation_summary or an explicit requires_legal_review flag — a Red constraint with no mitigation_summary and requires_legal_review=false is an invalid output, not a stylistic gap.

rationale_summary.description: Short distillation — full rationale is in regulatory-feasibility.md's Feasibility Summary

source_reference.description: KB chunk id (e.g. kb-L2-domain-regulatory#allergen-labelling) or regulatory-db lookup reference

regulation.description: The specific named regulation/section — not prose, kept in full

name.description: Constraint name — short label, not prose, kept in full

rationale_summary.description: Short distillation — full rationale is in the artifact

mitigation_summary.description: Short, still-actionable distillation. Required (non-null) if status is Amber or Red, unless requires_legal_review is true. Full mitigation detail is in the artifact.
